_doc: MAP V2 ROADMAP R6(a) SIGNAL-STRENGTH (research/open_questions.md: 'ladder position of every root, gate passed/date/next gate, from research/ bookkeeping made machine-readable'). Hand-compiled 2026-07-30 by reading research/experiments.md and research/open_questions.md for explicit ROOT VALIDATION LADDER gate-status language (CLAUDE.md defines gates 1-5: DATA/SIGNAL/LOGIC/SIZING/EXECUTION). Every entry carries a source_ref pointing at the file/line or session date the status came from, so a human or a future session can re-verify rather than trust this file blindly — same discipline as entity_map.json's provenance notes. This is a SNAPSHOT, not a live feed: it reflects the ladder position as of last_update_date per root and goes stale as new gate runs land; a future session should re-run the compilation (or extend it) periodically, not treat it as self-updating. RAW overlays (status raw_only, current_gate 0) make no predictive claim by design — the ladder does not apply to them, they are not 'behind' signal roots that failed a gate. Status values: raw_only, gate1_pending, gate1_pass, gate1_fail, gate2_pending, gate2_pass, gate2_fail, gate3_pass, gate4_pass, gate5_pass, killed.

roots.name: GRID VISION ML tower/substation detector
roots.note: Held-out-region AP50 0.197 (10-region diversity campaign, gv-div5-ks run) vs the pre-stated 0.30 bar, flat against a smaller NZ-only run — falsified the 'diversity fixes generalization' hypothesis; closed and superseded by HIFLD authoritative vector data.

roots.name: HIFLD transmission/substation/plant vector data (DHS/Oak Ridge)
roots.note: 94,216 transmission segments (69-765kV) + 75,328 substations + 11,810 plants, nationally surveyed, public domain; adopted as the authoritative replacement for the killed ML tower detector, no ladder gate needed (raw vector overlay).

roots.name: SEC Form 4 insider-buy/sell clustering signal
roots.note: GATE 2 KILL in both directions: code-S sales mirror test and full-8-quarter code-P re-run both reversed the stated prior significantly at 60d; the underlying gate-1 archive pipeline stays live and backfilling regardless.

roots.name: SEC bulk-historical Form 4 archive (parser/DATA layer)
roots.note: DATA-ladder gate 1 pass for the parser itself; the archive keeps backfilling independent of the gate-2 kill on the clustering hypothesis above.

roots.name: EDGAR 13F institutional new-position clustering
roots.note: Gate 1 (parser accuracy on hand-checked real filings) PASSED; gate 2 (new-position clustering vs forward returns) waits for a second consecutive quarterly filing period in the archive, earliest useful cut ~Oct-Nov 2026.

roots.name: USAspending.gov contract awards → ticker signal
roots.note: Gate 1 (recipient→ticker matcher) passed 2026-07-24 after fixing 2 real bugs; first gate-2 run 2026-07-26 came back honestly INCONCLUSIVE (archive too young for the 20d horizon) — infrastructure proven, not yet killed or passed.

roots.name: CFTC Commitments of Traders (Legacy) positioning extremes
roots.note: Gate 1 DATA passed 2026-07-05 (0 rejections across 156-week backfill, 7 symbols). Gate-2 screen killed GLD/CORN/SPY/QQQ/TLT outright and, after a Newey-West HAC correction, also killed SLV; only USO survives as a quantified-but-unpromoted carry (p=0.0355, fails the multi-comparison Bonferroni bar) — explicitly not promoted to LOGIC gate 3.

roots.name: CFTC Traders in Financial Futures (leveraged-money positioning)
roots.note: GATE 1 PASSED: accounting-identity validation (dealer+asset_mgr+lev_money+other_rept, including each category's own spread leg, must sum to CFTC's reported tot_rept total; tot_rept+nonrept must equal open_interest — same discipline as the passed Legacy-COT gate 1) wired into server/cftcTff.ts as tffAccountingIssues(), gating fetchLatestTff before archiving. Verified live against the actual shipped function: 0 rejections across 15,000 real records spanning 305 distinct report weeks, full dataset range 2006-06-13 through 2026-07-21 (both the earliest and most recent history sampled). Gate 2 (leveraged-money positioning extremes vs forward returns) not yet attempted.

roots.name: FINRA daily short-volume (4-facility CNMS reconstruction)
roots.note: GATE 1 PASSED: 100.000% sum-of-parts identity across 12,240 symbols vs FINRA's own 4 independent per-facility files, 0 unknown market codes; gate 2 (short-ratio extremes vs forward returns) explicitly not yet attempted, needs archive depth.

roots.name: SEC MIDAS market-structure stats (customer/MM volume splits)
roots.note: Raw feed gate 1 passed; the map/API display itself ships RAW (no ladder gate needed, precomputed SEC ranks/ratios as-is). The HFT-colonization-filter gate-2 hypothesis remains explicitly unattempted.

roots.name: SEC 8-K Item 2.02 earnings-language tone signal
roots.note: Gate 1 (DATA) shipped 2026-07-04. First gate-2 pilot (2026-07-12) found a preliminary 1-day tone-vs-forward-alpha association but explicitly flagged N as far too thin to trust; QoQ language-delta feature not yet testable (needs a second quarterly filing per company).

roots.name: ATS (Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby/SmartRecruiters) job-posting resolver
roots.note: GATE 0 KILLED for the broad name-guessed sweep-the-whole-panel form: verified coverage on a 25-ticker panel was 0/25 (0%) after manually disproving all 4 raw schema-level hits as name collisions with unrelated VC-backed startups; a narrower hand-verified watchlist variant remains legitimate but unbuilt.

roots.name: Sentinel-1/2 optical+radar tank-shadow inventory estimate (Cushing)
roots.note: v2 (S2 optical, 24-mo backfill): delta r=-0.06, sign hit 0.50 → FAIL, confound-quantified as pure sun-angle artifact with no residual inventory signal. v3 (S1 radar double-bounce): delta r=+0.056, sign hit 0.544 → FAIL. Two sensors, two designs, both dead at gate 1 on free 10m imagery.

roots.name: Google Trends via pytrends
roots.note: Layer of death: DATA/access. Stability passed (median cross-pull r=0.998) but availability failed: round 3 of a 3-round test collapsed to 6/20 on HTTP 429s (Google rate-limits the unofficial path after ~45 pulls/35min); the only client library (pytrends) is also upstream-archived.

roots.name: Wikimedia pageviews (retail-attention proxy, pytrends replacement)
roots.note: Adopted as the pytrends-gate-1-fail replacement and live-probed successfully (real daily counts); no explicit gate-1 pass/fail statistic found in the record.

roots.name: Corporate/LLC aircraft fleet utilization (ADS-B spine join)
roots.note: GATE 1 (spine join accuracy) PASSED 20/20 exact N-number matches vs independent adsbdb registrations. Gate 2 (utilization deltas vs forward returns/earnings) not attempted, needs a registrant→beneficial-operator resolution step first (FAA registrants are dominated by trustee/leasing shells).

roots.name: Entity map: facility/plant operator → ticker table (Everything Graph step 1)
roots.note: 44/69 operator entities hand-verified against SEC filings/investor-relations pages, 25/69 honestly logged as unmapped gaps, no guessed tickers; unblocks the fusion generation×operator gate 1.

roots.name: GEM satellite methane-plume × extraction-registry proximity join
roots.note: Gate 1 (plume detection itself, calibrated by GEM/CarbonMapper/GHGSat) is effectively trivial. Gate 2(a) (proximity join + map layer) SHIPPED 2026-07-19; gate 2(b)-(d) (repeat-detection rate, base-rate control, disclosed-emissions matching) explicitly not done — still not a signal.

roots.name: EPA UCMR5 PFAS drinking-water detections
roots.note: 3,539 systems with ≥1 detection, 3,417 geocoded; shipped as RAW/factual (a detected concentration is EPA's own published record, not an MCL-exceedance or health-risk claim) — no gate-2 needed, no predictive claim made.

roots.name: USGS M2.5+ global earthquake feed
roots.note: RAW layer shipped v1.0.209, archive-first from day one; insurer-exposure and utility/infrastructure-proximity gate-2 hypotheses filed but explicitly not attempted, blocked on accumulating archive depth.

roots.name: NOAA NDBC buoy observations (~889 stations)
roots.note: RAW layer shipped v1.0.220, archive-first; sea-state/shipping-lane and pressure-tendency storm-precursor hypotheses filed with ladder paths but not attempted, archive only started the same day as filing.

roots.name: VIIRS/SNPP night-lights radiance (GIBS layer)
roots.note: RAW display layer shipped v1.0.224, no predictive claim; not yet archived as a daily series (a prerequisite for the metro-radiance-delta-as-GDP-proxy hypothesis), and even the mechanical gate-1 tile/date-alignment spot-check was not yet done.

roots.name: NASA FIRMS active-fires layer
roots.note: Scaffolded/shipped as a RAW overlay, archive-first from day one; no predictive claim, no gate-2 attempt found in the record.

roots.name: FRED macro regime series (31 series, point-in-time vintage archive)
roots.note: Gate 1 PASSED 10/10: prod values exact-matched FRED's own fredgraph.csv export across daily/weekly/monthly cadences. Used as a regime-conditioning input, never traded alone — no standalone gate-2 signal claim.

roots.name: European macro cluster (ECB/Eurostat/Bundesbank)
roots.note: All 5 curated series (EUR/USD, €STR, Eurosystem balance sheet, EA20 industrial production, 10y Bund) live end-to-end matched the pre-deploy workup exactly.

roots.name: JODI World oil closing-stock levels
roots.note: Gate-1 first look found an honest non-match against our own EIA artifact for US crude, attributed to a definitional gap (lease stocks, SPR treatment), not a data error; reconciling JODI's stock definition against EIA remains the open gate-1 workup.

roots.name: EIA-930 hourly grid demand by balancing authority
roots.note: GATE 1 PASSED: EIA's Grid Monitor dashboard is itself rendered from this same region-data API (no separate third-party ground truth exists), so the honestly-available check is an independent re-draw of the API at a later time — computeRevisionStats() (server/gridDemandRevision.ts) + a live probe (scripts/gate1_eia930_revision_probe.ts) drew the full 12-respondent/48h/D+DF window twice, 9 minutes apart: 1,140 comparable cells, 37 revised (3.25%), 0 exceeding the 2% material-revision threshold, max |diff| 0.24% (NW respondent); the gate-1 target respondent (US48) itself moved by at most 0.05% across the two draws. Extends a prior single-anecdote check (one US48 hour, 1.1% one-time revision) into a systematic instrument; a single 9-minute-separated run, not a multi-day battery — a future session could widen the separation window or repeat across several days for additional confidence, but the measured magnitude is already far below any decision-relevant threshold for a RAW display with no predictive claim yet. Gate 2 (degree-day-adjusted demand residual vs industrial-sector returns) not yet attempted.

roots.name: NRC daily nuclear-plant status/outage reports
roots.note: Ladder path defined (gate 1 = NRC report parse matches registry units) as an outage-adjacent trade hypothesis joined to the power-plant registry; no build or gate-1 run found in the record.

roots.name: NOAA SWPC space-weather (Kp/R/S/G scales, aurora oval)
roots.note: Gate-1 archiver SHIPPED (6 keyless feeds polled every 10 min) but gate 1 explicitly remains open: the OE-417 storm-coincident-outage-excess validation runs only once a G2+ geomagnetic-storm window lands in the archive (quiet-sun weeks prove nothing); gate 2 untouched.

roots.note: RAW stats live now (gap events, identity-swap candidates, STS-zone loitering, counts-only with a coverage-loss caveat); gate-1 validation plan defined (vs OFAC SDN/KSE Institute reference-list vessels) but not yet run per the record.

roots.note: Charter-filed as a RAW layer first (lake/river levels + trend indicators) with drought/low-water hypotheses (ag futures, barge draft limits) logged with ladder paths; no gate-1 run found in the record.

roots.name: App Store rank + review-velocity (16-app consumer watchlist)
roots.note: GATE 1 (DATA) SHIPPED v1.0.568: daily chart-rank + rating-count archiver for a 16-app hand-verified watchlist (DUOL/BMBL/MTCH/HOOD/COIN/RBLX class), US/GB/CA storefronts. Sober prior stated before building: the most arbitraged alt-data category, expect near-zero on large caps. GATE 2 (rank/velocity vs company-REPORTED metrics, e.g. DUOL DAU/bookings) needs ~90 days of archive history, earliest ~2026-10-30 — not yet attempted.

roots.name: GitHub org engineering-momentum (15-org small-cap devtools watchlist)
roots.note: GATE 1 (DATA) SHIPPED v1.0.574: weekly merged-PR + commit-count archiver for a 15-org hand-verified develop-in-public watchlist (MDB/ESTC/NET/DDOG/SNOW/TWLO/HUBS/PD/FROG/WIX/U/ASAN/MNDY/PLTR/BRZE), each ticker+org login independently web-verified live (caught one stale M&A assumption: CFLT dropped, IBM acquisition closed 2026-03-18). RAW-DATA overlay only, no predictive claim yet. GATE 2 (velocity deltas vs forward returns, develop-in-public names only) is unstarted — sober prior expects real structure for maybe a third of the panel, noise for the rest.
